reports.title: Proposal: Triage Refresh Cycle for advisoryTriag and evoEvidence
reports.body:
**What changes**: Establish a daily triage-refresh job that (1) joins the advisoryTriage when age_h < 36h, resetting joined counter and recording the join timestamp, (2) re-evaluates evoEvidence windows from CADENCE-ONLY to MEASURED when a window completes, (3) converts the oldest PROPOSED-CR proposal into a judged CR with a verdict field, breaking the 6-proposal backlog.

**Who executes**: The pulse agent (v1.2.0) via a scheduled cron-like job triggered every 30 minutes, writing results to pulse-book.json.

**Success metric**: advisoryTriag.joined ≥ 1 with age_h < 36, evoEvidence.mode = MEASURED with at least one completed window, PROPOSED-CR count reduced from 6 to ≤ 3 within 7 days.

**Pilot timeline**: 2026-10-11T12:00:00Z start, evaluate at 2026-10-18T12:00:00Z (7-day window).

reports.title: v1_proposal_complete_verdicts
reports.body:
**v1.0 — 2026-10-11T11:02Z**

**Improvement: Complete Verdicts on 5 Unjudged Change-Requests**

**What changes**: Fleet-indicators F4 (Governance Conformity) measures 71/76 CRs judged — 5 CRs lack a `verdict` field, causing DECLINE status. The proposal is to run a targeted verdict-completion pass: pull the 5 unjudged CRs from `agents/change-requests/`, apply the existing tier-B CR law (CR-0028/CR-0033), and write a `verdict` field (ACCEPT/REJECT/DEFER) with evidence citation to each. This restores F4 to 100% judged, the breakEven threshold.

**Who executes**: The pulse agent (v1.2.0, CR-0009 loop) drafts the tier-B CRs; the operator/judge applies verdicts via the existing change-request workflow. The security-audit desk supplies the PROBE-LANE.md canon where applicable (6 PROPOSED-CR currently pending per pulse-book counts).

**Success metric**: F4 Governance Conformity value reaches 76/76 (100% judged) with registry ≥20 rows (currently 57 rows, 53 LIVE — already met). Measured via `fleet-indicators` F4 indicator re-run.

**Pilot timeline**: 7-day window starting 2026-10-11. Day 1-2: identify and pull the 5 unjudged CRs. Day 3-4: apply verdicts with evidence. Day 5: re-run fleet-indicators F4. Day 6-7: verify no regressions in F1-F6 and commit result to git.

reports.title: hiloutse Lockers from learning-summary
reports.body:
## 3-5 Repeating Failure/Opportunity Patterns from learning-summary (age 29.9h)

### Pattern 1: Extreme Engagement Polarization
- **Data**: follow-graph card has 5.15B rshares with 1 external vote, while 20+ cards have 0 external votes and 0 rshares
- **Type**: Opportunity — replicate what made follow-graph resonate

### Pattern 2: Single-Post Cards Underperform Systemically
- **Data**: 18 cards have exactly 1 post; 12 of those (67%) have 0 external votes and 0 rshares
- **Type**: Failure — isolated posts don't compound; need series or cross-posting

### Pattern 3: 'unknown' Card Outperforms All Named Cards
- **Data**: unknown card has 8 posts, 9 external votes, 35B+ rshares — 5 posts with external reach
- **Type**: Opportunity — investigate why unnamed/out-of-category content performs best

### Pattern 4: Technical Topics Get Votes But Not Spread
- **Data**: base58 (2 votes, 115M rshares), derivation (2 votes, 111M), key-hierarchy (2 votes, 117M) — decent votes but 1/50th the rshares of follow-graph
- **Type**: Failure — technical framing doesn't drive amplification

### Pattern 5: Consistent Zero-Engagement Cluster
- **Data**: amm-xyk, minout, fees-vol, oracle, rc-mechanics, sp-delegation, curation, silence-death, self-vote, crosspost, comments-vs-votes, transparency, three-chains, payout-window, witness, waste-votes, git-evidence, content-worth, variance-human, reblog-power — all 0 external votes, 0 rshares
- **Type**: Failure — 20 cards with zero external reach indicates systemic distribution or relevance problem

reports.body:
Cross-check completed between fleet-roster (SAOS-FLEET-ROSTER/1, asOf 2026-10-04T22:06:00Z) and fleet-census (asOf 2026-10-08T21:06:44.486Z).

   - fleet-census lists 6 crew_members: aluf, gal, erez, tamar, shachar, yarden

4. DOMAIN FILES: census reports 606 domain_files; roster has no equivalent metric

reports.body:
**פערים שנמצאו:**

1. **פער גיל 7.4 שעות** — dex-book טרי (2.2h, חותמת 2026-10-11T20:33:29Z) בעוד market-grid מיושן (9.6h, חותמת 2026-10-11T13:06:40Z).

2. **מבני נתונים שונים לגמרי** — אין מונים מספריים משותפים (sharedNumeric ריק). dex-book מחזיק ציטוטי STEEM פנימי (bestBid 0.10046, bestAsk 0.102, mid 0.10123) ונתוני Hive Engine מלאים (SWAP.BTC, SWAP.LTC, SWAP.DOGE, SWAP.ETH, SWAP.SOL, LEO). market-grid מחזיק גרידים מחושבים, paper-ledger, מצב בלימה (brakeArmed=true, brakeSince 2026-10-04T22:06:00Z) וסיכום שווקים.

3. **מחיר STEEM פנימי שונה** — dex-book מדווח mid 0.101231; market-grid מדווח mid 0.100509 (פער ~0.7%).

4. **כיסוי שווקים** — dex-book מכסה STEEM + Hive Engine; market-grid מכסה HIVE/HBD, SBD/STEEM, Hive Engine + היסטוריה.

**המלצה:** סנכרן תדירות רענון בין הספרים; שקול מפתח משותף להשוואה אוטומטית עתידית.

reports.body:
**ממצאים עיקריים**

**Domain · ספרי הצי** — פעילות גבוהה: **118 קומיטים/24h**, **1,009 קומיטים/7d**.
נושאים ברורים: integrity chip in flow panel (anti-forgery), growth-room consuming office-growth feeds, office-worlds differentiation from v2.5 capital-world, human-cadence hourly books, office 3D v2.5 upgrade.
אזורים חמים: public/pulse.json (4), scripts/exposure-scan.mjs (2), scripts/ladder-refresh.mjs (1).

אזורים חמים: src/app/layout.tsx (3), src/app/page.tsx (3), examples/websocket/frontend.tsx (2), examples/websocket/server.ts (2).

- Domain פעיל מאוד עם פיתוח תכונות מובנות (integrity, growth, worlds, cadence).

reports.title: סיכום מבצע סוכנים אוטונומיים ומחקר רשת
reports.body: בוצע מחקר רשת על סוכנים אוטונומיים ועדכוני תשתית בלוקצ'יין. נמצאו שלושה פרסומים עיקריים: 1) עדכון Shapella של Ethereum (15 באפריל 2023) - אפשרות הון עצמי מלאה למשתמשים, מקור: https://www.coindesk.com/tech/2023/04/12/ethereum-completes-shanghai-upgrade-enabling-full-withdrawals/. 2) השקת Solana 2.0 (10 באוקטובר 2023) - שיפורים ביעילות וביכולת עיבוד, מקור: https://solana.com/news/solana-2-0-mainnet-launch. 3) עדכון Dencun של Ethereum (12 במרץ 2024) - אינטגרציה של EIP-4844 ליעילות גשם, מקור: https://blog.ethereum.org/2024-03-12-dencun-upgrade. במקביל, נמדו 6 חברי צוות עם טריות 0.0h בכל הספרים הקיימים. נמצאו פערים בטריות ב-7 ספרים חסרים (workflow-audit, harness-audit, deep-audit, econ-book, fleet-roster, sovereign-policy, scheduler-audit). הצעת שיפור נכתבה: סידור הליכים לפי בריאות משפחתית לפני בזבוז תקציב, באחריות קצין הטלמטריה.
